context: M27 o10. Rita's bar, closing. Tina with a suitcase, or without one.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: I'm staying, Del. I told Lonnie no. He laughed. Then he stopped laughing.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Save me the second chair. I'll learn hair at night school.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: I'm going, Del. My aunt in Philly. Away from Lonnie. Away from me.

lines.speaker: char.tina_mercado
lines.text: Rule twelve: there is no rule twelve. Send me a postcard of your shop.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Whatever you do, Tina, count it first.
